status: DRAFT (not registered; SPEC_SHA256 None; k_tests, census scales and cuts null until the censuses)

experiments.F: CH184 alone or with the crowd

k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 8); fixed at registration, never changed; a size-scenario failure sets only its own tests to p = 1 (1.8)
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of live_tests5.py, live_tests5_analysis.py, live_tests5_base.py, bounce_decomp.py

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: crypto = fee_type starts with 'crypto' or the first series slug matches slug_regex (section 13, finding 2)

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug' (one family: one spot driver)

move.class_rule: never_traded (ltp absent at k-1 and k) > traded (L or V+) > ambiguous (V-, ltp present at k-1 and absent at k, or volume24hr unknown) > quote_only (not L, V0); geometry for every unit: parallel (sign db = sign da = sign x, both >= 0.005, |db - da| <= 0.005), one_sided (min(|db|,|da|) <= 0.0005), spread_change (opposite signs, both > 0.0005), same_side_unequal (rest)

j.rule: traded |x| >= 1c sampled movers; tick known and equal at k-1, k; steps = round(|x|/tick) >= 3; interval rows t_{k-1} <= ts < t_k (t_k = sample origin_utc, t_{k-1} = the market's row receipt in capture k-1); covered if the page is not full or its oldest row of the market is at or before t_{k-1}; >= 3 interval rows with a known outcome; levels = distinct YES-terms prices snapped to the tick of k; g_path = clip((levels-1)/steps, 0, 1); jump <= 0.25, grind >= 0.75

f.rule: family: non-neg-risk event with >= 3 other usable members, else the first series slug with >= 3 (siblings in the unit's own neg-risk event excluded), else none; usable = two-sided and tight at k-1, k and received <= t_unit + 5 s; xbar = leave-one-out mean x; idio |xbar| < 0.25|x|; common clip(xbar/x, -1, 2) >= 0.75

o.rule: O = |g| x m, g = mid_k - 24 h size-weighted YES-terms VWAP, m = s_YES - s_NO (notional = size x token price); 24 h coverage required; own mid changes NaN when a slot is missing

h.rule: origin = the 00:31Z slot of each UTC day only; mark over slots k-84..k-1 with spread <= 0.10; state change since k-12 (mid, hi or lo); unknown previous state excluded

r.rule: rewarded = summed clob_rewards daily rate active on the capture's UTC day > 0; folded sweep-1 mid f in [0.84, 0.96) outside |f - 0.90| < 0.005 (fake cutoffs from 0.59); inside = f <= 0.90; imb = (D_bid - D_ask)/(D_bid + D_ask) at the census-fixed band

gates.perm_method: Freedman-Lane (J, F, H, R); block circular-shift Freedman-Lane (O) (LIVE_TESTS_5.md 1.8)

size_check.rule: rate <= nominal + 1.645 sqrt(nominal (1 - nominal) / worlds) per scenario; one run on the code to be pinned, after the censuses; a failing scenario sets only the tests it is binding for to 'SE check failed (size scenario)', p = 1, k unchanged; no rerun, reseed or variant

census_inputs.capture_seal: docs/research_lab/seals/lt5_census_inputs_captures.json (written from the releases' files.sha256 before any LT5 census)
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / census days (estimate); effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the population (H: units on both census days)

mde_common.rule: gate on max(section 8 class formula, design-SE formula) where both apply (section 16)
